title: Relay keys revoked (DELETE /api/tournaments/:slug/relay-keys, 200)
description: No current sender (OpenPairings only ever POSTs). No body; ?label= revokes that label only, without it every key this publisher made for the slug. 200 also when nothing was revoked. A suspended installation may still withdraw. Refusals as for the POST, minus tournament_not_published and relay_key_limit.
